name: wimbly
description: Connect your Wimbly account and finish onboarding from Claude or Codex.

interface.longDescription: Wimbly is a business-development analyst for partners at professional-services firms. This preview guides account setup: connect your mailbox and LinkedIn, review your background, and confirm your ideal clients. It reads setup progress and links to Wimbly's website for each step. An enrolled Wimbly account is required. This release handles onboarding only; research and outreach happen in Wimbly's mail panel.

publication.release_notes: First preview: guided Wimbly onboarding. Live sign-in verification is pending.
